notes.notes:

notes.title: The Mooseman Release Date, Price and More
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27768439/573157cf1e4e197d8c5e19426e1bc48d539558c2.jpg

Hey everyone!

Vladimir here to tell you about why we make a release at 17th of February exactly, what will be the price and such stuff.

Our game is dedicated to the pagan finno-ugric mythology of ancient permian tribes, local to the town that our small team lives in (Perm, Russia). Mythology was materialized in bronze casted objects, with a unique style, called Perm Animal Style and these artefacts were the foremost inspiration for the game. All these myths that the object depict were lost during christianization process, so we had to reconstruct them, and we did that as best as we could. 

The descendants of these so called Chud' tribes are now known as Komi-Permians. It is their ancestors who created all the bronze animal style objects.  So the date of the release was chosen for a reason. 17th February is the day celebrating the Komi-Permian language, which now slowly disappears from regular use. We will celebrate it by remembering all the old stories and beliefs, that our game strives to bring forward from the sands of time.

Our game is a hobby-project, so the duration is short, about couple of hours, maybe 3 if you will collect all the secrets (which are kind of cryptic) and read all stories. The game will go live on 17th February for 6.99$. 

Thank you for stopping by to read our announcement and hope to see you in the ancient worlds of pagan myth!

--Vladimir
